content: {"Critical care paramedic Rod Wells: It's a privilege to do the job that we do, but it's thanks to kind donations and fundraising from the communities that we serve that critically injured and unwell people can have the best possible chance of survival."}
{"Coldham Hall Tavern: We are sure you have read about the drowning of a teenager in the river at Beccles, it was a tragedy and our thoughts and condolences go out to his family and friends."}
